title: City Reliquary

card.teaser: An identity for a museum of everyday objects, built on a negative-space CR mark.

summary: An identity for a community museum of everyday objects, built on a negative-space CR mark.
meta: CR mark, identity system, posters, signage

hero.alt: A red t-shirt printed with the white City Reliquary mark, worn against a graffitied wall.

overview.challenge: City Reliquary is a community museum in New York City for everyday artifacts and the stories they hold. The identity had to make ordinary objects feel worth keeping.
overview.solution: A compact CR mark built from negative space, as the anchor for a system that stretches across posters, signage and promotional pieces.
overview.outcome: One recognizable mark, flexible enough to move between formats without losing its voice.

items.alt: A second City Reliquary poster mockup.
